errors.text_span: Das Diagramm stellt die Terminpreiskurve für Jahreslieferungen im Marktgebiet von Trading Hub Europe (THE) dar.
errors.evidence: The figure contains two separate plots, one for "Sommerlieferungen" (summer deliveries) and one for "Jahreslieferungen" (annual deliveries). The description incorrectly describes it as a single diagram and only mentions the title of the second plot.
This describes the x-axis range of the left plot only. The right plot's x-axis ranges from 2026 to 2029. The description incorrectly conflates the two.

errors.text_span: Die erste Linie... Die zweite Linie...
errors.evidence: The description hallucinates a single chart with two lines. The figure actually shows two separate charts, each with one line.
Both lines in the two plots clearly use square markers to indicate data points. The description incorrectly states they have no markers.

The description seems to be describing the first plot (Sommerlieferungen) here. The value in 2027 for that plot is approximately 31 Euro/MWh, not 33.3. The value 33.3 Euro/MWh is the approximate value for the second plot in 2027, further highlighting the confusion between the two plots.

This statement describes the second plot but incorrectly implies that the line ends in 2028. The plot for 'Jahreslieferungen' continues to the year 2029, where the price drops to approximately 27 Euro/MWh.
